speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To begin our evaluation, how long has your baby been having trouble breathing, and were there any complications during the birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity.

Given the infant's gestational age of 33 weeks and onset of distress within two hours of birth, I need to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
